lateral_torso_line_topology.vertical_line_count_and_spacing: 11 distinct vertical white lines; spacing is relatively uniform across the mid-torso with slight compression observed toward the posterior flank.
lateral_torso_line_topology.intersection_coordinates_bifurcations: A Y-shaped topological split is visible at the dorsal terminus of the 10th line (counting from anterior to posterior); partial merging observed between the dorsal origins of lines 2 and 3.
lateral_torso_line_topology.discontinuity_mapping: The anterior-most line (Line 1) is a truncated segment terminating mid-torso; several posterior lines exhibit fragmentation or fading near the ventral margin.

posterior_constellation_clusters.spatial_cluster_density: A cluster of approximately 5 high-contrast white spots is located on the mid-to-lower region of the posterior haunch.
posterior_constellation_clusters.linear_blob_alignment: Horizontal alignment of 3 distinct spots forming a geometric line across the upper-mid posterior thigh.

macro_horn_vector_geometry.curve_trajectory_2d: Straight, conical spikes projecting posterodorsally at approximately 55 degrees from the nasal plane; lyrate curvature is absent.
macro_horn_vector_geometry.apical_span_ratio: Estimated 1.1:1 ratio between the terminal horn tips and the lateral width of the horn bases.

other_distinctive_markers: Bright white chevron marking on the nasal bridge; distinct white patch on the upper throat; white spot visible on the lower mandible/cheek region.
